examples.ja: 自爆テロ犯はベナジル・ブット元首相に向けて発砲したが、弾はそれた。
examples.en: The suicide bomber fired towards former Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto, but missed.

examples.ja: ２００６年９月の軍事クーデターで失脚、事実上亡命中だったタイのタクシン元首相が２８日、約１年半ぶりに帰国した。
examples.en: Deposed in a military coup in September 2006 and having effectively been in exile, the Former premier of Thailand Thaksin has returned after about a year and a half.
